set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/hrf and modules/design. Acceptance: refine Seconds into validated time/domain wrappers where useful; introduce HrfKind/typed HRF specs and scalar-HRF capability; represent stimulus/event schedules as typed records instead of parallel vectors; add bound formula phase with typed column refs/basis refs/contrast refs; add typed event/condition/factor/term/column ids and first-class DesignError/Either entry points. Verification: hrfJVM/test, hrfJS/test, designJVM/test, designJS/test plus parity fixtures that currently cover formula/design behavior.
set.title: Type HRF specs, event schedules, formulas, and design metadata
